mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate robust economic demand that strengthens corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1900 and GDPC1 > 11400, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market tightness that triggers inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 135000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates weakening economic activity that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 200.0), declining housing starts (HOUST) signals cooling demand that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200.0 and HOUST < 1950, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates monetary tightening in response to inflation, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
